These are manifest data files (documentation strings describing other files), not actual imports — they're plain string literals in a build-manifest generator, not `import` statements. They don't import anything themselves, so they're excluded.

That confirms the real importer set. Final list of files that actually `import` symbols from `src/lib/rate-limit.ts`:

- `src/app/api/webhooks/inbound/route.ts`
- `src/server/services/search-service.ts`
- `src/server/services/invitation-service.ts`
- `src/server/services/comment-service.ts`
- `src/server/services/auth-service.ts`
- `src/actions/auth/login.ts`
- `src/actions/auth/reset-password.ts`
- `src/actions/comments/create-comment.ts`
- `src/actions/members/invite-member.ts`
- `tests/lib/rate-limit.test.ts`

Files like `tests/services/*.test.ts`, `tests/server/plan-limits.test.ts`, and `tests/server/_support/doubles/misc.ts` only reference the module path in `vi.mock(...)` or comments/reimplementations — they never write an `import ... from "@/lib/rate-limit"`, so they're excluded. `src/actions/_lib/action-errors.ts` and the `scripts/manifest-parts/*.ts` files only mention it in comments or documentation strings, not real imports.

ANSWER: src/app/api/webhooks/inbound/route.ts, src/server/services/search-service.ts, src/server/services/invitation-service.ts, src/server/services/comment-service.ts, src/server/services/auth-service.ts, src/actions/auth/login.ts, src/actions/auth/reset-password.ts, src/actions/comments/create-comment.ts, src/actions/members/invite-member.ts, tests/lib/rate-limit.test.ts
